heading: Two Wisconsin Administration Officials Receive National Recognition
source: Wisconsin Department of Administration press release
summary: The Department of Administration said two of its leaders earned awards for their government work. Richard Rydecki received an operations award from the National Association of State Chief Administrators. Dan Subach received a Midwest regional award from the National Association of State Budget Officers.

heading: Wisconsin Sues Over Loss of Unemployment System Funding
summary: Wisconsin DOJ and the Department of Workforce Development joined a challenge to a federal funding decision. The lawsuit concerns money for fraud prevention and improvements to state unemployment insurance systems. Thirteen other states joined the filing.
